text:
rachel: Hey folks, just joined and my first on-call rotation starts Friday. I hit two blockers: (1) PD invite shows 'user already exists' but I'm not on the schedule, (2) the 'service-runbooks' space returns permission required. Who can help untangle?

omar: Welcome Rachel! For PD oddities we usually remove stale PD user then re-invite. @infra-bot can you check "pd-stale-cleanup" for rachel? Also confirm Okta group membership 'oncall' and 'eng-prod'.

infra-bot: Infra: Created ticket INC-4999 to remove stale PagerDuty entry for rachel and reissue invite. Confluence permissions updated attempt logged (task #CC-210).

rachel: Thanks. Also curious about a quick checklist for the rotation: what's mandatory vs recommended? Trying to prioritize before Friday.

omar: Mandatory: PagerDuty active + mobile, access to #prod-alerts & #eng-oncall, ability to open Incident Manager entries, and read access to service runbook you're covering. Recommended: Grafana dashboards bookmarked, test alert practice, and a 20m pairing with your buddy.

tz: I can do a 20m smoke sim Thu 11am PT if that helps. We do a cold alert (no hints) and a guided replay. Also I'll show how we use the incident comms template and PD notes. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/3312

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Test alert queued for @rachel and @tz in 60s. This is an automated simulation.

rachel: Small ops question: when acknowledging in PD should we always annotate an 'initial hypothesis' in the note field?

omar: Yes please. One-line hypothesis helps triage and makes handoffs clearer. If mitigation is applied, note exact command or config change. Example: "ACK: hypothesis - spike due to delayed SQS consumers; mitigated by scaling workers + restarting queue-processor v3"

ops-docs-bot: Docs: Quickstart runbook list: "service-runbooks/index", "pagerduty-basics", "incident-comm-template". If you see 403 on confluence, request group add with subject: "oncall access: <your-name>" in #help.

rachel: Cool — infra ticket created and pairing Thu 11am works. Will follow up if PD invite still borks. Thanks! :thumbsup:
